observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black PlayStation 4 console in a white box, with two black DualShock 4 controllers, a power cable, and a UK-style plug.
The console has a visible 'PS4' logo on the top left corner in both photos.
The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 models, with some visible wear and smudges on the touchpad area.
The power cable is coiled and attached to the console.
The console is placed on a wooden surface, and the box is open, suggesting it is being sold as-is.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims 'Genuine UK Used Sony PlayStation 4 With Games Installed, Pads and all accessories'.

identity.kind: PlayStation 4 console with two controllers and accessories

claims.evidence: The console has the 'PS4' logo visible in both photos, but there is no visible proof of origin (e.g., UK-specific packaging, labels, or serial number). The term 'genuine' cannot be verified remotely.
No games are visible in the photos. The console's screen or internal storage cannot be shown to confirm games are installed.
Two DualShock 4 controllers are visible in both photos, and a power cable is present. No other accessories (e.g., HDMI cable, USB cable, game disc) are shown, but the claim is partially supported.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, power supply)
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game, or a photo of the console's screen with a game loading.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated/illegal
risks.proof: A photo or video of the console's home screen showing installed games, or a screenshot of the game library.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/axis
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses and analog sticks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers may not work

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: A photo of the console's serial number and a verification check via Sony's official website or a trusted third-party service.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially blacklisted or stolen

proof_requests: Photo of the console's serial number and model number (usually on the back or bottom).
Video showing the console powering on and booting up, with a game playing.
Photo or video of the console's home screen showing installed games.
Video showing both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Photo of the console's power adapter and any included cables (HDMI, USB, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
